axes.name: Jace and planeswalkers
axes.definition: Creating or growing a Jace token, putting loyalty counters on a planeswalker, or putting a planeswalker onto the battlefield, so cards that check for a planeswalker, behold a Jace, or trigger on loyalty counters and loyalty activations turn on.

axes.name: Scry and surveil
axes.definition: Scrying or surveilling, including the Jace token's [-1], which triggers or turns on cards that care whether you scried or surveilled this turn.

axes.name: Noncombat damage to opponents
axes.definition: Dealing noncombat damage to an opponent (pings, burn to face, drain triggers, attack triggers), which turns on recursion, pumps and keywords for cards that check whether an opponent was dealt noncombat damage.

axes.name: Noncreature spells cast
axes.definition: Casting a noncreature spell, including a copy of a prepared creature's spell or a flashback cast, which triggers prowess, Thopter and Treasure makers, team pumps and empower triggers.

axes.name: Cards in your graveyard
axes.definition: Putting cards into your own graveyard by milling, surveilling, discarding, cycling or casting spells, to reach threshold and power cards that count or scale with graveyard size.

axes.name: Lands in the graveyard
axes.definition: Putting land cards into your graveyard by self-mill, surveil, or sacrificing or discarding lands, for cards that return lands from the graveyard or care about the biggest card there.

axes.name: Creature recursion
axes.definition: Getting creature or planeswalker cards into your graveyard (dying, milling, discarding) for cards that return, exile or count creature cards from the graveyard.

axes.name: Sacrifice and death triggers
axes.definition: Providing creatures, tokens or planeswalkers that can be sacrificed or that die readily, feeding sacrifice costs and cards that trigger whenever a creature you control dies or when several died this turn.

axes.name: Life gain
axes.definition: Gaining any amount of life, through lifelink, drain effects or incidental gain, which triggers cards that grow, draw or make tokens whenever you gain life.

axes.name: +1/+1 counters
axes.definition: Putting +1/+1 counters on creatures you control, so cards that grant abilities to countered creatures, move or double counters, or cost less for counters turn on.

axes.name: Creatures entering
axes.definition: Having creatures, including creature tokens, enter under your control each turn, for cards that trigger whenever another creature you control enters or that count your creatures.

axes.name: Creature tokens
axes.definition: Creating creature tokens such as Cadets, Thopters and Beasts, for cards that pump, untap, count or sacrifice tokens or care about Wizard or artifact tokens.

axes.name: Artifacts
axes.definition: Having artifacts on the battlefield, including Heartwood, Treasure and Thopter tokens, Equipment and artifact creatures, for cards that count, tap or sacrifice artifacts or trigger on casting them.

axes.name: Landfall
axes.definition: Having lands enter under your control beyond the normal drop: land fetching, extra land drops and land tokens, for landfall triggers and cards that count lands or specific basic types.

axes.name: Legendary permanents
axes.definition: Controlling or holding legendary cards, for cards that cost less with a legend, return or discard legendary cards, or put counters on legendary creatures.

axes.name: Discard outlets
axes.definition: Effects that let you discard cards (looting, rummaging, cycling, discard costs), feeding cards that trigger when a card is discarded or that want to be discarded from hand.

axes.name: Extra mana
axes.definition: Producing mana beyond your land drops: Heartwood, Treasure and Lotus tokens, mana creatures, rituals and mana rocks, which lets expensive spells and large activated abilities come online early.

corrections.reason: ETB searches a basic land onto the battlefield tapped, an extra land beyond the drop, the same ramp as a mana creature.
'{3}{G}, Discard this card' is a discard cost, so it triggers discard payoffs such as Tinybones (already a partner) once.
ETB returns a milled land card to the battlefield tapped, an extra land beyond the drop; strength 1 because it depends on milling a land.
'{1}{W}, Discard this card: It deals 4 damage' is a discard cost, so it triggers discard payoffs such as Tinybones once.
Garruk's -3 makes each opponent discard two cards, and Tinybones deals damage whenever a player discards; Rank Rat and Solve for Disappointment already carry this partner for the same reason.
'{B}, Discard this card: Target creature gets -3/-1' is a discard cost, so it triggers discard payoffs such as Tinybones once.
The granted [-2] is a sacrifice outlet ('You may sacrifice a creature. If you do, create a 4/4 Beast'), so it wants fodder, like Garruk, Veiled Butcher's -2 which is tagged payoff 1.
The -2 ('Discard your hand, then draw a card for each creature you control') discards your cards, feeding Tinybones and Jiang Yanggu, Alone, like Arc of Fortune which is tagged an outlet.
